title: PC build — a price/performance estimator (round 1, design D)

steps.headline: PC build estimator: a build mixing new and used parts, compared on value.
steps.hint: Open Pages (grid button in the top bar), then PC build. Try New/Used switches, clicking a part name to pick another, the resolution switch, and the builds under the chart.
steps.notice: Builder's main guide gaps: the guide's section on Pages is three lines; the Pages style kit lacks switches, notices, menus and charts and contradicts the guide in places; nothing on charts or big numbers.
steps.risk: Where prices come from is undecided. Save as a new build and Try again aren't wired.
